#!/bin/sh
set -eu
base=/etc/node1-https
current=$base/current
threshold=604800
if [ "${1:-}" != "--force" ] && [ -r "$current/tls.crt" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$threshold" -noout -in "$current/tls.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo 'certificate remains valid beyond renewal threshold'
    exit 0
fi
release=$base/releases/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$
linktmp=$base/.current-$$
umask 027
install -d -m 0750 -o root -g nobody "$base/releases" "$release"
trap 'rm -f "$linktmp"; if [ ! -L "$current" ] || [ "$(readlink "$current" 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$release" ]; then rm -rf "$release"; fi' EXIT HUP INT TERM
openssl req -new -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -days 30 -config "$base/openssl.cnf" -keyout "$release/tls.key" -out "$release/tls.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1
chown root:nobody "$release/tls.key" "$release/tls.crt"
chmod 0640 "$release/tls.key"
chmod 0644 "$release/tls.crt"
ln -s "$release" "$linktmp"
mv -Tf "$linktmp" "$current"
command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1 && restorecon -R "$release" "$current" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
serial=$(openssl x509 -in "$current/tls.crt" -noout -serial)
enddate=$(openssl x509 -in "$current/tls.crt" -noout -enddate)
echo "renewed $serial $enddate"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/node1-https-renew"; sudo /usr/local/sbin/node1-https-renew --force

#!/usr/bin/python
from BaseHTTPServer import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from SocketServer import ThreadingMixIn
import ssl

CERT = '/etc/node1-https/current/tls.crt'
KEY = '/etc/node1-https/current/tls.key'

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'
    def do_GET(self):
        body = 'node1 HTTPS service is healthy\n'
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'text/plain')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        return

class ReloadingTLSServer(ThreadingMixIn, HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True
    def get_request(self):
        sock, addr = self.socket.accept()
        try:
            tls_sock = ssl.wrap_socket(sock, server_side=True, certfile=CERT,
                                       keyfile=KEY, ssl_version=ssl.PROTOCOL_TLSv1_2)
            return tls_sock, addr
        except Exception:
            sock.close()
            raise

ReloadingTLSServer(('0.0.0.0', 8443), Handler).serve_forever()
